positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked in Core Services division to support multiple Java/SpringBoot applications through bug fixes and feature requests.
Utilized Test-Driven Development and pair programming to ensure maintainable and high quality code.
Began work on a new AWS pipeline with AWS Lambda and CloudFormation which replaced legacy modules.

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer and Graphic Designer
positions.description:
I created a new brand design including a modern logo, website, and documents in addition to designing, creating, and managing the Market Builders Inc. website and related information.
Recently, I set up a G-Suite account for all employees and migrated data from the last provider.

positions.title: Frontend Web Developer
positions.description: At Vail Systems, our team created an application to allow both engineers and customers to create email and SMS notifications from their application metrics.  During the internship, I created the React UI, connected the UI to the backend Rails API, and implemented the UI/UX team's design to create a contemporary platform for managing application alerts.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Figma (Software) · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Instructed the lab section of an introduction to C class.
Graded labs, exams, quizzes, and homework.
Lead office hours where students could receive tutoring on class material.
